description: Captures a screenshot of a web page (or of raw HTML) in a real browser and returns the hosted image URL. By default the image is also returned inline so you can see it — except for full_page captures, which are often too tall to view; set include_image=true to force it. Supports viewport or full-page capture, a single element via 'selector', a pixel region via 'clip', retina output, ad/cookie-banner blocking, CSS/JS injection, clicking elements first, dark mode, custom headers/cookies, proxies, geolocation, and timezone. Each call uses one screenshot credit unless a cached capture is served.

accept_languages.description: Accept-Language header for localized content, e.g. 'fr-FR,fr;q=0.9'. Default 'en-US,en;q=0.8'.

adjust_top.description: Scroll the viewport down this many pixels before capture. Default 0. Not supported for PDFs.

block.description: Resources to block while rendering. For a clean capture use ['ads', 'cookie_banners', 'chat_widgets']. 'tracking' blocks analytics. 'javascript', 'stylesheets', 'xhr', and 'fetch' can break pages or hide content — use only when needed. Others: images, media (audio/video), fonts, text_tracks, event_source, websockets, manifest.

block_specific_requests.description: Specific request URLs or patterns to block, separated by commas, spaces, or newlines, e.g. 'https://example.com/api/data, https://ads-domain.com'.

blur_selector.description: CSS selector(s) of elements to blur, comma-separated — for redacting emails, account numbers, or other sensitive data.

bucket_name.description: Bucket to use with byob when several are configured under the same service.

byob.description: Save the output to your own bucket configured under Storage Integrations in the dashboard (Bring Your Own Bucket). Default false.

click_recursion.description: How many times to click selector_to_click in sequence. Requires selector_to_click. Default 0.

clip.description: Capture only this rectangle of the page.

cookies.description: Cookies to set before loading, as 'name=value; other=value;'. Use for pages behind a login.

css.description: CSS injected before capture, e.g. '.header { display: none; }'.

css_url.description: URL of an external stylesheet to inject before capture.

custom_html.description: Raw HTML to render instead of loading a URL. Takes precedence over url. Inline CSS and JavaScript in the HTML are applied. Useful for pages that are not publicly reachable.

dark_mode.description: Render with the dark color scheme (for sites that support it). Default false.

delay.description: Extra wait in milliseconds after the page loads, before capture. Default 0. Use 1000-5000 for animations, charts, or late-loading content.

enable_caching.description: Store this capture in the cache for reuse. Cached captures served later (with fresh=false) do not consume credits. Default false.

enable_incognito.description: Render in an isolated incognito session with no persisted cookies or storage. Default false.

file_type.description: Image format. Default png. jpg is smallest (see image_quality); webp balances size and quality. For PDF use generate_pdf.

fresh.description: true (default) always renders a new capture; false returns a cached capture when one exists from a request with enable_caching=true and identical parameters.

full_page.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Default false. Combine with lazy_load for pages with lazy images.

grayscale.description: Desaturate the output, 0 (full color, default) to 100 (fully grayscale).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers as 'Name: value;' pairs separated by semicolons, e.g. 'Authorization: Bearer abc; X-Test: 1;'.

height.description: Browser viewport height in pixels (max 4320). Default 876.

include_image.description: Return the image inline in the tool result so you can see it. Default true, or false when full_page is true. Images above SCREENSHOTAPI_MAX_INLINE_IMAGE_BYTES (default 3500000 bytes) are returned as a URL only.

js.description: JavaScript executed in the page before capture, e.g. "document.querySelector('.popup').remove();".

js_url.description: URL of an external JavaScript file to execute before capture.

latitude.description: Latitude reported by the browser Geolocation API.

lazy_load.description: Scroll through the whole page first so lazy-loaded images and sections render. Default false.

longitude.description: Longitude reported by the browser Geolocation API.

omit_background.description: Make plain white/solid page backgrounds transparent (png only). Default false.

proxy.description: Proxy to route the request through: 'address:port' or 'username:password@address:port' (an http:// prefix is accepted). Useful for geo-specific content or CAPTCHA-prone sites.

remove_selector.description: CSS selector(s) of elements to remove from the page before capture, comma-separated, e.g. '.ad-banner, #sidebar'. Non-matching selectors are ignored.

result_file_name.description: Custom file name for the stored output. Non-unique names can overwrite earlier files.

retina.description: Render at 2x pixel density for a sharper, larger image. Default false.

save_path.description: Optional local path to also save the file to, e.g. './shots/home.png'. A directory path (ending in '/' or an existing directory) keeps the remote file name. Relative paths resolve against the MCP server's working directory.

scroll_delay.description: Milliseconds to wait between scroll steps when lazy_load is true. Default 500. High values on long pages can hit the timeout.

scroll_to_element.description: CSS selector of an element to scroll into view before a viewport capture.

selector.description: CSS selector of a single element to capture instead of the viewport, e.g. '#pricing' or '.product-card'.

selector_to_click.description: CSS selector of an element to click before capture, e.g. to open a tab, dropdown, or accordion.

sizes.description: Capture the page at several viewport sizes in one request, e.g. [{width:1920,height:1080},{width:768,height:1024},{width:390,height:844}]. Overrides width/height. Returns one hosted image per size; images are not shown inline in this mode.

storage_service.description: Storage service to use with byob when several are configured: 'aws', 'wasabi', or 'google_cloud'.

template_id.description: ID of a saved cookie template from the ScreenshotAPI dashboard to apply before navigation.

thumbnail_width.description: Resize the output to this width in pixels, keeping the aspect ratio. Handy for previews and to keep inline images small.

timeout.description: Maximum milliseconds the API waits for the page to load before aborting. Default 100000.

timezone.description: IANA timezone to emulate, e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Karachi'. Default is the server timezone.

ttl.description: Cache lifetime in seconds when enable_caching is true. Default 2592000 (30 days).

url.description: Website URL to render, including the protocol, e.g. 'https://example.com'. Either url or custom_html is required.

user_agent.description: Custom User-Agent string, e.g. a mobile Safari UA to get the mobile site.

wait_for_event.description: Page lifecycle event to wait for before capture. 'load' (default) waits for all resources; 'domcontentloaded' is faster but may miss images; 'networkidle' waits until no network requests for 500ms — best for SPAs and dashboards.

width.description: Browser viewport width in pixels (max 7680). Default 1680. Use ~390 to emulate a phone, ~768 for a tablet.

name: take_screenshot
title: Take a website screenshot
